headline: Non-US/chronic shine, US pricing/trade generics drag

highlights: However, mid-single digit YoY growth in trade generics kept overall India growth in check for Alkem.  Volume growth was robust in US market, although it was offset by price erosion intensity in 2Q.
The scale-up of certain products like g-tolvaptan has also been gradually impacted overall US sales for the quarter.  We largely maintain our estimates for FY27/FY28.

We value Alkem at 27x 12-month forward earnings to arrive at a TP of INR5,890.  FY27 is the year of consolidation for Alkem, as the new business is facing a gestation period before scale-up, with operational cost front-loaded and revenue yet to pick up.
